rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate AIN for 6G; present integrated architecture and networking; survey enabling technologies; present modeling/performance analysis; survey optimization; list challenges; conclude.

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Architecture and enabling sections use diagrams and tables; modeling/optimization sections include performance figures; challenges are text-heavy.

figures.purpose: depict integrated AIN architecture and functional components

tables.purpose: summarize AIN configurations or protocol components

lesson_blocks.lesson: Integrated architecture splits into satellite configuration, protocols, and functional components to manage complexity.
SDN/NFV, MIMO, mobility control, and AI are key levers to realize AIN flexibility.
Different AIN combinations require tailored performance models.
Platform-specific optimization (HAP, UAV, satellite, heterogeneous) reflects unique resource constraints.
Future directions mirror architecture/enabling/optimization gaps (flexibility, AI interference, mobility, O&M, resource mgmt, simulation).

synthesis.aha_moment: Stacking architecture -> enabling tech -> modeling -> optimization -> challenges gives a clear path from design to open problems for AINs.

style.section_openers_pattern: State design focus (architecture, tech, modeling, optimization) then enumerate subcomponents.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Architecture-to-challenges pipeline
steps: Lay out integrated architecture and protocols.
List challenges that mirror earlier components.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Gives readers a linear path from design to gaps for a complex integrated system.

notes: Counts heuristic; many figures/tables. Organization heavy in intro; challenge list aligns with architecture/enabling/optimization topics.
